snapshot.caption: shopnorivals.com

body.text:
We owe you an apology. 🧢

We may have made it a little too easy to become a No Rivals fan.

We’re hearing that people are:

• “Accidentally” grabbing hats for multiple schools
• Replacing perfectly good hats with new ones
• Fighting over who gets more space on the hat rack
• Saying they have enough hats… then coming back for another

Honestly, we should’ve seen this coming.

We’re sorry for making premium collegiate headwear too hard to resist.

But if you’re going to have a hat problem, you might as well have a good one.

Shop No Rivals. 👇
